## --- QC_TR ---

PM_R_4 <- read_csv(file.path(path_val, "Pm_R_dis.csv"))

## --- QC_CP ---
QC_CP_1 <- read_csv(file.path(path_val, "QC_CP_alpha_metrics.csv"))

QC_CP_2 <- read_delim(
  file.path(path_val, "QC_CP_crown_sinuosity.csv"),
  delim = ";",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

QC_CP_3 <- read_csv(file.path(path_val, "Qc_Cp_CrownMetrics.csv"))
QC_CP_4 <- read_csv(file.path(path_val, "QC_CP_dis.csv"))
QC_CP_Br <- read_delim(file.path(path_row, "QC_CP_Branch.csv"),
delim = ";",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
QC_CP_Can <- read_csv(file.path(path_sect, "QC_CP_CanopySector.csv"))

add_file_id <- function(df) {
  if ("file_name" %in% names(df)) {
    df %>% mutate(file_id = sub("\\.[^.]+$", "", file_name))
  } else if ("FileName" %in% names(df)) {
    df %>% mutate(file_id = sub("\\.[^.]+$", "", FileName))
  } else {
    stop("Né 'file_name' né 'FileName' trovati in questo df.")
  }
}

QC_TR_1   <- add_file_id(QC_TR_1);   QC_TR_2   <- add_file_id(QC_TR_2)
QC_TR_3   <- add_file_id(QC_TR_3);   QC_TR_4   <- add_file_id(QC_TR_4)
QC_TR_Br  <- add_file_id(QC_TR_Br);  QC_TR_Can <- add_file_id(QC_TR_Can)

QC_CP_1   <- add_file_id(QC_CP_1);   QC_CP_2   <- add_file_id(QC_CP_2)
QC_CP_3   <- add_file_id(QC_CP_3);   QC_CP_4   <- add_file_id(QC_CP_4)
QC_CP_Br  <- add_file_id(QC_CP_Br);  QC_CP_Can <- add_file_id(QC_CP_Can)

FS_HF_1   <- add_file_id(FS_HF_1);   FS_HF_2   <- add_file_id(FS_HF_2)
FS_HF_3   <- add_file_id(FS_HF_3);   FS_HF_4   <- add_file_id(FS_HF_4)
FS_HF_Br  <- add_file_id(FS_HF_Br);  FS_HF_Can <- add_file_id(FS_HF_Can)

PM_R_1    <- add_file_id(PM_R_1);    PM_R_2    <- add_file_id(PM_R_2)
PM_R_3    <- add_file_id(PM_R_3);    PM_R_4    <- add_file_id(PM_R_4)
PM_R_Br   <- add_file_id(PM_R_Br);   PM_R_Can  <- add_file_id(PM_R_Can)

merge_all_by_file_id <- function(...) {
  Reduce(function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "file_id"), list(...))
}

QC_TR_validation <- merge_all_by_file_id(QC_TR_1, QC_TR_2, QC_TR_3, QC_TR_4, QC_TR_Br, QC_TR_Can)
QC_CP_validation <- merge_all_by_file_id(QC_CP_1, QC_CP_2, QC_CP_3, QC_CP_4, QC_CP_Br, QC_CP_Can)
FS_HF_validation <- merge_all_by_file_id(FS_HF_1, FS_HF_2, FS_HF_3, FS_HF_4, FS_HF_Br, FS_HF_Can)
PM_R_validation  <- merge_all_by_file_id(PM_R_1,  PM_R_2,  PM_R_3,  PM_R_4,  PM_R_Br,  PM_R_Can)

dim(QC_TR_validation)
dim(QC_CP_validation)
dim(FS_HF_validation)
dim(PM_R_validation)

## Data selection

```{r}
library(dplyr)

prep_tree_df_for_index <- function(df) {

df1 <- df %>%
select(
-any_of(c(
"file_name.x","alpha","n_points_crown","file_name.y","Pop.x","file_name.x.x",
"source.y","Pop.y","source","cr_percent","crown_pa.x","file_name.y.y",
"parent","lenght","angle","crown_length.y","crown_base_height.y",
"crown_volume","File_Name","file_name"
))
)

df_br_123 <- df1 %>% filter(order %in% c(1, 2, 3))

br_sum <- df_br_123 %>%
group_by(file_id) %>%
summarise(vol_br_ord1_3 = sum(volume, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

tree_1row <- df1 %>%
select(-order, -volume, -length, -FileName) %>%
distinct(file_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

left_join(tree_1row, br_sum, by = "file_id")
}

QC_TR_tree <- prep_tree_df_for_index(QC_TR_validation) %>% mutate(pop = "QC_TR")
QC_CP_tree <- prep_tree_df_for_index(QC_CP_validation) %>% mutate(pop = "QC_CP")
FS_HF_tree <- prep_tree_df_for_index(FS_HF_validation) %>% mutate(pop = "FS_HF")
PM_R_tree <- prep_tree_df_for_index(PM_R_validation) %>% mutate(pop = "PM_R")

ALL_tree <- bind_rows(QC_TR_tree, QC_CP_tree, FS_HF_tree, PM_R_tree)
```

```{r}
cv <- function(x) {
x <- x[is.finite(x)]
if (length(x) < 2) return(NA_real_)
sd(x) / mean(x)
}

gini <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  x <- sort(x)
  if (sum(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  n <- length(x)
  (2 * sum((1:n) * x) / (n * sum(x))) - (n + 1) / n
}


rng <- function(x) {
x <- x[is.finite(x)]
if (length(x) < 2) return(NA_real_)
max(x) - min(x)
}
```

```{r}
calc_SH_variables <- function(df) {
df %>%
group_by(pop) %>%
summarise(
cr_density_R = rng(crown_density),
cr_width_to_cr_length_CV = cv(cw_cl_ratio),
cbh_GC = gini(crown_base_height.x),
branch_volume_1_2_3_R = rng(vol_br_ord1_3),
cr_disp_to_height_R = rng(crown_displacement / tree_height),
cr_surface_area_GC = gini(crown_surface_alpha),
cr_area_to_cr_volume_CV = cv(crown_pa.y / crown_volume_alpha),
cr_sinuosity_GC = gini(crown_sinuosity),
.groups = "drop"
)
}

SH_all <- calc_SH_variables(ALL_tree)
SH_all

```

```{r}

score_01_p125_p875 <- function(x) {
pL <- as.numeric(quantile(x, 0.125, na.rm = TRUE))
pU <- as.numeric(quantile(x, 0.875, na.rm = TRUE))
if (!is.finite(pL) || !is.finite(pU) || pU == pL) return(rep(0.5, length(x)))
s <- (x - pL) / (pU - pL)
pmin(1, pmax(0, s))
}

vars8 <- c(
"cr_density_R",
"cr_width_to_cr_length_CV",
"cbh_GC",
"branch_volume_1_2_3_R",
"cr_disp_to_height_R",
"cr_surface_area_GC",
"cr_area_to_cr_volume_CV",
"cr_sinuosity_GC"
)

SH_scored <- SH_all %>%
mutate(across(all_of(vars8), score_01_p125_p875, .names = "score_{.col}")) %>%
rowwise() %>%
mutate(
SHI_TLS = sum(c_across(starts_with("score_")), na.rm = TRUE),
SHI_TLS_0_100 = SHI_TLS / length(vars8) * 100
) %>%
ungroup()

SHI_TLS <- SH_scored %>% select(pop, SHI_TLS, SHI_TLS_0_100)
write_csv(SHI_TLS, file.path(output, "SHI_TLS_scored.csv"))

```
